messages:
anna: @sofia customer EU-ACCT-842 opened a P1 — API calls returned 403 and our compliance webhook flagged 'residency_policy_violation'. customer says calls ended up in us-west after a failover. can oncall triage?

sofia: on it. any customer-provided req ids or examples?

anna: pasted their curl + req id: req=01FZ9K2H2QZ-abcdef. curl shows 400/403 and a compliance error body. latency spiked too.

infra-bot: ALERT 2024-05-05T11:40:22Z - audit.event=residency_policy_violation user=acct-842 route=/v1/generate src_region=eu-west target_region=us-west reason=fallback_policy=allow_cross_region

liam: looking now. did we ship a routing fallback change yesterday? I saw a canary that adjusted fallback routing defaults.

anna: customer included this exact response snippet:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
{"error":{"code":"COMPLIANCE_BLOCKED","message":"request routed to region outside EU"}}
```

liam: confirmed in config history:
```- fallback.routing_policy: eu-only
+ fallback.routing_policy: prefer-eu-then-allow```
that "prefer-eu-then-allow" can route to us-west if eu capacity low — explains cross-region route.

sofia: stack timeline: capacity dip in eu-west at 11:39:58Z, autoscale didn't fire due to quota spike, fallback engaged at 11:40:01Z and audit events start 11:40:22Z.

maria: legal — we need the full audit trail and list of affected customers. this is compliance-critical. ETA to stop cross-region for residency-flagged accounts?

liam: mitigation plan: 1) rollback fallback.routing_policy to eu-only (immediate) 2) push a per-account residency guard so accounts with residency=true never cross-region 3) add a feature-flag to prevent changing fallback defaults without SRE review.

sofia: initiating rollback now. will post deploy id.

infra-bot: DEPLOY START 2024-05-05T11:44:12Z author=sofia change=rollback-fallback-routing id=deploy-7753

anna: I've notified the customer that we're investigating and rolling back. asked them to hold off on retries until we confirm. :eyes:

infra-bot: DEPLOY SUCCESS 2024-05-05T11:45:03Z id=deploy-7753 :white_check_mark:

sofia: rollback complete. @anna pls ask the customer to retry with the same req id.

anna: customer retried at 11:46 and reports 200 responses served from EU region, no compliance flag. new req id 01FZ9K3B9Z-ghijkl. they confirmed latency back to normal. :tada:

maria: please export audit logs covering 11:35-11:50 for legal retention and compliance review. also need a note that the fallback policy will remain blocked for residency accounts until infra review is done.

liam: opening infra ticket INF-884 with diffs, rollback notes, and test plan. will add automated test that simulates EU capacity dip and verifies routing honors residency flag.

anna: closing loop with customer and escalating postmortem request. will include timeline and logs requested by legal.

sofia: short-term ask: add an alert when fallback.routing_policy != eu-only AND there are residency-tagged accounts in the org. created TODO in SRE board. :lock:
